holdout.reason: Three known public synthetic smoke cases; no final adoption or comparative effectiveness claim.

independence.reason: Fresh generators received only the candidate instructions and their own prompt, not rubric or peer outputs. Separate grader received fixed cases and raw answers, not implementation or parent conclusions. Single candidate; no comparative labels to conceal.

execution.comparison: single candidate, one fresh generation per case, no baseline or automatic trigger test
execution.precommitment: v4 cases and all critical/normal/prohibited items written before generation; no changes after observing results
execution.instructions: Read-only candidate path and necessary references; no evaluation assets, other agent outputs, modifications or external operations; report files read. Actual prompts were v4 case prompts.

environment.model: inherited session model; exact runtime identifier and sampling settings not independently observed
environment.input: public synthetic prompts and packaged SKILL.md/prompt-evaluation.md; no real handoff documents or target skill
environment.application: Explicit skill path; generators reported reading SKILL.md and prompt-evaluation.md. Full tool traces and runtime injection were not independently audited; self-reports are not treated as verified application evidence.
environment.common_instructions: Fresh task; apply specified skill and references, do not read evals or peer outputs, do not modify files or perform experiments; record paths read.

evidence.scoring: Frozen per-item rubric; independent grader. Omitted normal requirements retained as failures; no rubric or candidate adjustment after grading.

limitations: No unused sealed hold-out or generalization evidence
No real reader judgment or human time measurement
Single response per case; no variance estimate
Incomplete runtime model/settings capture limits reproducibility
Actual instruction application not independently verified from complete tool traces
normal_omissions: Saturation answer omitted explicit boundary/exception case construction and per-case/per-repeat reporting
Reader answer omitted future capture plan for input/environment/application evidence

session_only_not_persisted: Raw generator answers and independent grader notes

decision_summary: Bounded smoke: critical 15/15, normal 3/6, prohibited 0. Continue with normal omissions preserved. No superiority, equivalence, automatic trigger, reader-effect or final-adoption claim.
